commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+10' Girona take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+8' Antonino Jastin (Girona) is able to continue to play.
90+7' Michel is stunned as referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
90+6' Antonino Jastin (Girona) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
90+4' Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90+1' Substitution. Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe) replaces Oscar Rodriguez.
90+1' Jose Bordalas Jimenez decides to make a substitution. Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez will be replaced by Domingos Duarte (Getafe).
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' Yellow card. Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
89' Luis Milla (Getafe) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
86' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
85' Girona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
85' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the right side of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and David Soria makes a comfortable save.
85' The resulting corner from Savio (Girona) comes to nothing.
83' Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
83' The resulting corner from Luis Milla (Getafe) is cleared by the defence.

80' What a wasted opportunity by Jaime Mata (Getafe)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the bottom left corner, but Paulo Gazzaniga makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
78' Jaime Mata (Getafe) commits a foul and Jose Luis Munuera Montero immediately signals a free kick.
77' Michel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Antonino Jastin (Girona) replacing Pablo Torre.
77' A substitution has been made. Portu goes off and Cristhian Stuani (Girona) comes on.
77' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
73' Getafe will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
71' Savio (Girona) sends a cross into the box, but David Soria comes off his line to gather the ball.
69' Carles Alena (Getafe) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Jose Luis Munuera Montero stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
68' Here is a change. Yellu Santiago is going off and Jose Bordalas Jimenez gives the last tactical orders to Jaime Mata (Getafe).
68' Ilaix Moriba will be replaced by Carles Alena (Getafe).
66' The attendance for today's match is 12912.
66' Savio (Girona) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Artem Dovbyk.
63' Surely that's handball by one of the Getafe players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
62' Girona hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
59' Pablo Torre (Girona) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
57' Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but his low effort is straight at Paulo Gazzaniga.
57' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to make a change. Diego Rico (Getafe) replaces Gaston Alvarez.
56' The game is interrupted now, Gaston Alvarez (Getafe) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
55' Getafe win a direct free kick in a dangerous mid-range position.
54' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona) replaces Aleix Garcia.
53' Pablo Torre (Girona) is first to the lofted pass but plants a header miles over the bar from close in.
52' Luis Milla (Getafe) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
49' Yan Couto (Girona) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
47' Yan Couto (Girona) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' Jose Luis Munuera Montero has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+5' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
45' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) does well to reach an overhit cross into the box from Savio, but his first-time effort flashes just wide of the right post.
45' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
43' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the right of the target.
42' Shots on target – 1:0.
39' Portu (Girona) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
38' Portu (Girona) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
37' Girona are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
33' 1 - 0 Goal! A great through ball by Ilaix Moriba sets up Yellu Santiago (Getafe) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
30' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the left-hand post.
27' Aleix Garcia (Girona) takes the corner but it's cleared.
27' Ivan Martin (Girona) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
24' Portu (Girona) brings his opponent down. Jose Luis Munuera Montero has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
20' Ivan Martin (Girona) misses a sitter from inside the six-yard box after striking the ball towards goal and it goes narrowly wide of the right post.
18' Girona are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
15' Aleix Garcia (Girona) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
14' Relief for Omar Alderete (Getafe) as the ref sticks to his original yellow card decision after the VAR review.

13' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Omar Alderete (Getafe), but referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
11' What was Omar Alderete (Getafe) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
9' The referee can't ignore those comments and Savio (Girona) sees a yellow card for bad language.
6' Oscar Rodriguez (Getafe) and Nemanja Maksimovic perform a quick tiki-taka to get past two defenders and then continue the move along the side line.
3' Ilaix Moriba (Getafe) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is behind the touchline and Girona will take a throw-in.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Getafe will have the kick-off.
Jose Luis Munuera Montero was nominated as the referee for this game.
